messages:
kate_fin: NovaSearch flagged an embed shortfall on Apr 12 invoice 1: their embed row count is ~9.2k lower than their dashboard. They sent sample request IDs. Can we investigate?
rachel_cs: Got their ticket. They're worried it's a data-loss bug; they want a reconciliation + possible credit. Adding samples: ns-req-9981, ns-req-9987.
josh_eng: Noted. We shipped SDK connector v3.1.0 to apac last week. There's an open bug (ENG-9701) about a batching ack edge-case in the apac ingestion proxy. Could be related.
priya_ml: If embeddings were dropped pre-ingest, counters won't increment. Can we correlate client-side ack vs server-side ledger?
marco_ops: I'll run a quick ledger query on the embed_ledger for NovaSearch for Apr 11-12 window. SQL: 
```
SELECT request_id, count(*) as rows, sum(size_bytes) as bytes
FROM embed_ledger
WHERE account = 'novasearch' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-04-11' AND '2026-04-12'
AND request_id IN ('ns-req-9981','ns-req-9987')
GROUP BY request_id;
```
Running now.
replay-bot: started replay job replay-2085-embed-nova for window 2026-04-11T00:00:00Z -> 2026-04-12T23:59:59Z (eta ~7m).
marco_ops: Quick results: those two request_ids show 0 ledger rows. Client received 200 OKs and got ids back, so likely batching ack didn't reach ledger.
sdk-bot: SDK v3.1.0 changelog note: "apac connector - switched to async ack path to reduce latency". Known issue: missing ack on partial-batch failure.
josh_eng: Confirmed: async ack path used a non-blocking callback that suppressed error path in some race conditions. We'll revert the change for apac connector and ship patch ENG-9701-fix.
priya_ml: How many rows total missing across the account for the window? Need to estimate dollar impact.
marco_ops: Running full account aggregation... query in progress.
marco_ops: Aggregation complete: reconstructed missing embed rows = 9,214 rows. Average vector dim=1536, billing metric = per-embed row.
priya_ml: NovaSearch negotiated embed price = $0.075 per 1k rows. So dollars = (9,214 / 1000) * 0.075 = $0.69. Hmm that's tiny; are we sure unit is per-row?
josh_eng: They are on legacy enterprise embed SKU which charges $75 per 1k rows (yes, high enterprise price). Priya's unit mix used the public rate. Use the contract rate: $75/1k rows.
marco_ops: Using $75/1k: (9.214 k * $75) = $690.99.
elena_finance: Can you also show whether retro-credit changes their committed tier or volume thresholds? Might be immaterial but check.
marco_ops: Committed tier check: their quarterly committed volume is 1.2M rows; this delta won't affect tier thresholds.
replay-bot: replay job replay-2085-embed-nova completed. Artifacts: s3://replay-exports/replay-2085-embed-nova.json. Missing rows manifest attached.
josh_eng: Patch ENG-9701-fix is ready; rolling to apac ingestion fleet now. Will follow up on post-deploy validation.
rachel_cs: Draft message to NovaSearch: "Hi NovaSearch - thanks for flagging. We found an SDK connector edge-case that caused ~9.2k embed rows to be ingested but not recorded for billing in APAC on Apr 11-12. We've applied a $691 credit and deployed a fix; monitoring is in place. Would you like a walkthrough?" Thoughts?
elena_finance: Small correction: round to nearest dollar and include S3 replay link + ticket numbers. Also require dev QA docs for audit. I can approve up to $1k without director sign-off.
josh_eng: Will attach ENG-9701-fix PR link and replay artifacts.
marco_ops: Creating BILL-1150, attaching replay export and ledger diff. Credit queued for next invoice.
priya_ml: We'll also add an eval to ensure embed quality/regression tests include ack-path coverage.
replay-bot: audit-log: bill-audit://BILL-AUDIT-2085 created.
marco_ops: BILL-1150 created, credit $691, artifacts: s3://replay-exports/replay-2085-embed-nova.json, PR: github.com/redwood/ingest/pull/2761 (ENG-9701-fix).
kate_fin: Sending final message to NovaSearch now. Thanks all.
elena_finance: Closing after audit attachments uploaded to BILL-1150. Keeping thread for incident channel summary.
